newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close mixed, heavyweights fall.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close mixed, heavyweights fall.

text.p: Malaysian shares closed mixed, with falls in some heavyweight stocks keeping the key market index in negative territory throughout the day.
"Telekom and Tenaga were down all day, but gains in counters like Maybank helped limit the index fall," said one dealer. "Buying again focused on Second Board stocks."
At the close, the benchmark Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks ended down 4.78 points at 1,239.35. The small-capitalised Second Board index rose 10.96 to 633.68.
Market volume was 354 million shares, with gainers leading losers 387 to 202.
Telekom fell 60 cents to 20.60 ringgit amid worries that a deadline for free competition could be brought forward.

Energy, Telecommunications and Posts Minister Leo Moggie said on Monday Malaysia has no immediate plans to bring forward an agreement over equal access to international phone networks from 1999. But it could do so if industry players agree, he said.
Analysts said there were also concerns of a change in a U.S. communications ruling which could bring down Telekom's international rates.
